[[Kunvie's Air Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Kunvie Firewing]], a [[boss]] in [[Unwaking Waters (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10 
:[[Lightning damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Air Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Air Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Air Magic]] +1 (20% chance while using skills)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a Canthan [[Air Staff (metal)|Air Staff]].
